content.rendered:
Quick reminder; our Carnival is tomorrow night, Friday May 5th, 4:30-7:30. Please note that this is not a drop off event. Our carnival gets very crowded and it’s important that students have an adult with them.

Please follow this LINK for the Update. Enjoy the sunshine, and we hope to see you at the carnival!
